 For the Opposite Party/s : Mr.Aditya Narayan Singh.1

 Oral Order
Heard learned counsel for the petitioners and learned APP.

2. Issue notice to the Opposite Party No. 2 by both modes i.e. registered cover with A/D as well as ordinary post for which requisites etc. must be filed on or before 5-1-2024, failing which the present quashing application shall stand rejected without further reference to the Bench.
3. Put up this case on 04-03-2024.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: In the meantime, the order dated 20-2-2017 passed Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.46909 of 2023(2) dt.18-12-2023 by the learned SDJM, Katihar in Complaint Case No. 772 of 2016, whereby cognizance of offence under section 498A of the IPC read with Section 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act has been taken, shall remain stayed.
5. The learned counsel for the petitioners submits that petitioners are husband, brother-in-law and mother-in-law of OP No. 2.

It is further submitted that this is the third case instituted by the OP No.
2 against her husband and his relative.
It is further submitted that the second case was dropped after the instant complaint case was filed.
It is next submitted that husband of the OP no. 2 was taken in judicial custody.

It is also submitted that he was suffering from kidney issues and both his kidneys have failed and he is on regular dialysis, and till date, 76 dialysis have been done on the husband of the OP No. 2.
(Satyavrat Verma, J) SUMIT/-
